codeReview.summary: The implementation correctly adds priority-based ordering to the processPending() method in sync-service.ts. The SQL CASE expression in the ORDER BY clause properly sorts operations by entity-type priority tier: Tier 1 (customers, products, product_variants, tags, customer_groups, suppliers), Tier 2 (sales, abonos, purchases, distribuciones), and Tier 3 (all others). Within each tier, created_at ASC ordering is maintained. The implementation matches the feature requirements exactly.
